name: Kindwise Insect.id
tagline: Image-based insect and pest identification for IPM and farm apps.
description: Kindwise Insect.id is a computer-vision API that identifies insects and pests from photos. It is used for integrated pest management (IPM), agricultural scouting, and livestock-adjacent pest monitoring apps that need species-level suggestions, confidence scores, and related metadata from uploaded images.

auth.details: API key via Api-Key header; self-serve signup on Kindwise / Insect.id portal.

pricing.free_tier_limits: 100 free API credits after registration; each successful identification costs 1 credit.

rate_limits: No request-count limits or caps are imposed. Requests exceeding SLA traffic conditions may be queued or processed more slowly, and performance guarantees may not apply.

example.request: IMAGE_B64="$(base64 < insect.jpg | tr -d '\n')" && curl -X POST "https://insect.kindwise.com/api/v1/identification" -H "Api-Key: YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data "{\"images\":[\"${IMAGE_B64}\"]}"

use_cases: identify an insect species from a photo
score pest ID confidence for IPM scouting
batch-check farm pest images for species labels
power livestock pest monitoring from phone photos
